title: #282 Agriculture
prompt: Despite the great progress in agriculture humans have achieved, there are still people who starve to death. Is there anything we can do to address the problem? Please give some possible solutions.

promptSegments.text: Despite the great progress in agriculture humans have achieved, there are still people who starve to death.
Is there anything we can do to address the problem?

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The major problem is that food cannot reach the poor people because of bad movement.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The major problem is that food cannot reach the poor people because of bad movement.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A good solution is to build better roads and keeping places to help move food.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A good solution is to build better roads and keeping places to help move food.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The major reason is the poor distribution of food resources.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The major reason is the poor distribution of food resources.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: One effective solution is improving global infrastructure and logistics.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: One effective solution is improving global infrastructure and logistics.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first major issue is the significant disparity in food distribution and access, where logistical failures and conflict zones prevent sufficient food from reaching those who need it most.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first major issue is the significant disparity in food distribution and access, where logistical failures and conflict zones prevent sufficient food from reaching those who need it most.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A key solution is implementing robust, sustainable farming practices in developing regions, which enhances local resilience and promotes self-sufficient food supplies.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A key solution is implementing robust, sustainable farming practices in developing regions, which enhances local resilience and promotes self-sufficient food supplies.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
